Source 2 Viewer CLI (ValveResourceFormat)
https://github.com/ValveResourceFormat/ValveResourceFormat

Dolly downloads the official Windows CLI on first use and verifies the pinned
release archive and executable by SHA-256. It is not bundled in the Dolly
source tree or release ZIP.

Pinned release: 20.1
Archive: cli-windows-x64.zip
Archive SHA-256: 67aaf8a67a85ca60fd09ff343e62103a4cdf3a2d177fc656231d7d734c5b3aa3
Source2Viewer-CLI.exe SHA-256: ef9f6fb3943c30b73f0991bce6654128727b0807968f7997a6bb014efbec8830
